canonical_statement: The two-dimensional incompressible Euler equations have a global-in-time solution for initial data in the bounded-vorticity Yudovich regime, subject to the domain, boundary, forcing, and solution-class hypotheses to be fixed from the primary source in the statement phase.
claim_boundary: The repository source describes global existence only. Uniqueness, continuous dependence, and any maximal generalization are excluded from the root until a primary-source scope audit authorizes them.
domain_and_universes: Provisional: a two-dimensional spatial domain and real time; exact domain regularity, scalar/vector spaces, universes, and measurable/topological structures are unresolved.
quantifiers: planar domain Omega (exact admissible class unresolved)
initial velocity u0 or initial vorticity omega0 (encoding unresolved)
time t in the nonnegative global time interval
a velocity/pressure or vorticity solution (solution structure unresolved)
hypotheses: bounded initial vorticity in the Yudovich regime
boundary compatibility appropriate to the selected domain
forcing assumptions, including whether forcing is absent, unresolved pending source audit
conclusion: Existence of a solution for all nonnegative times in the exact weak/strong solution class selected from the source.
